title: Nourishing Korean Fettuccine Mandu
description: Silky fettuccine noodles encased in savory mandu shape, infused with a rich soffritto base and tofu filling for a comforting Busan-inspired lunch.
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking.
Whisk the tofu, carrot, mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, sesame oil, gochujang, rice vinegar, salt, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Add potato starch to the filling mixture and stir until it thickens slightly to help bind the filling.
Lay a sheet of fettuccine flat and spread a thin layer of the filling on one end of the strand.
Fold the noodle over the filling to form a semi-circle, then pinch the edges together to seal, creating a mandu shape.
Place each formed mandu on a steamer tray lined with parchment paper to prevent sticking.
Steam the mandu over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until the noodles are fully cooked and the filling is heated through.
Remove the mandu from the steamer and let them rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the mandu hot, drizzled with a thin sauce made from the leftover soy sauce and sesame oil.
Optionally garnish with extra scallions or toasted sesame seeds for added flavor and texture.
